title: Uniqueness of literals by coordinate
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let a literal on $n$ coordinates consist of a coordinate and a required sign in $\ bz^\times$. A conjunction term is a list of such literals whose coordinates are pairwise distinct. If two literals in the same term have the same coordinate, then they are equal.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a conjunction term on $n$ coordinates
